title: Existence of a globally generated invertible sheaf with prescribed nonvanishing locus on an integral separated scheme

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of an element whose inverse lies in the Jacobson radicals of the local rings at the missing points
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the element f from which the cocycle for the line bundle is built.

core_obligations: Show that for each missing point the open U times_X Spec(B_i) is Spec(K), and use separatedness of X to conclude that the map A tensor B_i -> K is surjective (proof lines 7865-7871).
Apply the existence lemma to obtain a nonzero f in A with f^{-1} in every maximal ideal m_i (proof lines 7872-7873).

Choose opens U_i around the missing points on which f^{-1} is invertible, so that the U together with the U_i form an open covering of X, and define the 2-cocycle with values in O_X^* given by f on U cap U_i and by 1 on U_i cap U_j (proof lines 7874-7881).

Realize the resulting line bundle L with sections s (equal to 1 on U and to f^{-1} on U_i) and t (equal to f on U and to 1 on U_i), note X_t contains the union of the U_i, conclude that s and t generate L and that X_s = U (proof lines 7882-7890).
proof_roadmap: Identify the intersection of the affine open with the missing local models.
Find an element of A invertible-inverse at all the missing points.
Build the line bundle from an explicit cocycle.
Exhibit two generating sections and read off the nonvanishing locus.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a globally generated invertible sheaf L and a section s on an integral separated scheme X with U = X_s, where U is a nonempty affine open whose complement is a finite set of points with one-dimensional Noetherian local rings. The proof shows first that U times_X Spec(B_i) is Spec(K) for each missing point, and separatedness makes A tensor B_i -> K surjective; then it applies the existence lemma for an element f in A whose inverse lies in every maximal ideal, picks opens U_i around the points on which f^{-1} is invertible, and constructs L explicitly from the 2-cocycle given by f on the overlaps U cap U_i and by 1 on U_i cap U_j, exhibiting two sections s and t that generate L and satisfy X_s = U (proof lines 7864-7890). H2: the explicit cocycle construction and the verification that the two exhibited sections generate the line bundle are the substance.
